description: Solar Electric Programs Reported by NYSERDA: Beginning 2000 is a dataset listed in State of New York open data portal (data.ny.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of New York. This dataset includes information on completed and pipeline (not yet installed) solar electric projects supported by the New York State Energy Research and Development Authority (NYSERDA). Blank cells represent data that were not required or are not currently available. Contractor data is provided for completed projects only, except for Community Distributed Generation projects. Coverage: New York State. The portal files it under the category Energy & Environment. Its tags are solar electric, solar photovoltaic, inverter, mw, mwh. The table has 54 columns. Attribution on the portal: New York State Energy Research and Development Authority Solar Electric Programs. The portal shows 2026-09-04 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-ny-gov-portal.
